issues.symptom: npm @ucp-js/sdk 0.5.1 ships the discovery projection with the extends stub that #55 replaced on the response schema: CapabilityDiscoverySchema.extends is an unconstrained optional string, so a conformant array is rejected and any string accepted. CapabilityResponseSchema rejects it.

repro.command: npm install @ucp-js/sdk@0.5.1 && npm view @ucp-js/sdk version && node -e 'const s=require("@ucp-js/sdk");const b={name:"dev.ucp.shopping.checkout",version:"2026-08-25",spec:"https://ucp.dev/specification/checkout",schema:"https://ucp.dev/schemas/shopping/checkout.json"};console.log(s.CapabilityDiscoverySchema.safeParse({...b,extends:["dev.ucp.shopping.checkout"]}).success,s.CapabilityDiscoverySchema.safeParse({...b,extends:"NOT A REVERSE DOMAIN"}).success)'
repro.observed: false true at npm 0.5.1, re-run 2026-11-17; CapabilityResponseSchema rejects the same bogus string, so only the discovery leg is unfixed. The command published here previously grepped dist/schemas/*.d.ts, a path the package does not contain (dist holds cjs, esm, index.d.ts and src).
